name: mobility_radio
title: Joint aging and report-cost map with radio airtime charged
caption: 128 paired test frames per cell at N=4 and T=20 ms. Known jointly Gaussian initial/execution log gains. Stars mark a positive Bonferroni simultaneous 95% lower limit against no-report across 120 contrasts. No cell establishes superiority over predictive sensitivity. Only radio report airtime is subtracted.

name: mobility_charged
title: Joint aging and report-cost map with computation charged
caption: 128 paired test frames per cell at N=4 and T=20 ms. Known jointly Gaussian initial/execution log gains. Stars mark a positive Bonferroni simultaneous 95% lower limit against no-report across 120 contrasts. No cell establishes superiority over predictive sensitivity. Method-specific computation reservations are fixed on 128 separate development frames; observed overruns are charged.

name: q_accuracy
title: Report-value approximation accuracy
caption: Absolute Q errors for 256 candidate reports in 32 previously evaluated states. The reference uses convex minimization and Brent roots with 1e-8 endpoint tolerance. Candidates within a state are dependent. The horizontal scale is linear near zero. Adaptive integration tolerances are not uniform miss bounds.
